name: Parkcrest Elementary School

heroImage.alt: Excavators on site earthworks beside Parkcrest Elementary

lede: Civil works package C-028 for the new Parkcrest Elementary in Burnaby, including roads, a new parking area and full sewer and water upgrades.
body:
Over almost three years we carried the civil package for the new school: excavation, storm and sanitary, fire and domestic water, and the road and frontage works around the site.

The job closed out with a new parking area, curb and gutter, sidewalks and paving.
scope: Bulk and detailed excavation for new construction
Storm and sanitary sewer system upgrade
Onsite and offsite concrete curb and gutter, sidewalk and driveway
Road construction, asphalt overlay and new paving
New parking area with concrete curb and gutter
